mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as observed in historical monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1400.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 207.0 signals rising inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 207.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both decline (relative to prior month), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls (relative to prior month), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising) and economic expansion (GDPC1 > 11000.0), the S&P 500 underperforms due to dual pressure from higher discount rates and slowing growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 11000.0 and FEDFUNDS is rising, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 110.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
